title: fix(auth): an SSO-enforced login page shows no password copy while its config resolves and no email divider without an email form (objectui#12682)
body:
Fixes #12682
Clause-②: yes
Clause-② reason: `@object-ui/auth`'s exported `SocialSignInButtonsProps` gains one optional member, `hideDivider?: boolean;`, read on the built declarations: `dist/index.d.ts` re-exports it (`export { SocialSignInButtons, type SocialSignInButtonsProps } from './SocialSignInButtons.js';`) and `dist/SocialSignInButtons.d.ts` declares the member. It widens a published UI surface. No `@object-ui/types` member and no authoring key changes, and nothing is removed or renamed.

## What changed

- **`LoginForm`, the header while the config resolves.** While `configPending` is true, the header shows its title and no description. Before this change it showed the password form's description, either the component default or the `description` the host passed. Once the config answers, the description is the same as before: `labels.ssoOnlyDescription` under SSO-only mode and `description` otherwise. A failed config read still falls back to the password form and its description. The `hideHeader` branch already rendered nothing while pending, and a pin now holds that.
- **`SocialSignInButtons` gets `hideDivider`.** This optional boolean prop (default `false`) omits the "or continue with email" divider. Callers that leave it unset render exactly as before, including `RegisterForm` and every external caller. It is a boolean prop, not an empty `dividerText` acting as a special value.
- **`LoginForm` passes `hideDivider={!passwordFormVisible}`.** Under SSO enforcement the divider is withheld until "Use a password instead" is clicked. After that click the divider and the form show together, and "Back to single sign-on" hides both again.
- **Docs.** In `packages/auth/README.md`, the `orText` paragraph now says when the divider shows, and it documents `hideDivider` and the pending header. The `LoginFormProps.description` and `LoginFormLabels.orText` docblocks say the same.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/12682-sso-login-pending-copy.md` (`@object-ui/auth`: minor).

This adds no translation key. The pending header leaves the description out instead of showing new copy, so no bundle changes and `check:i18n-keys` was not needed.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)

## Live readings, before and after

**Setup.**
- Backend: objectstack `66d456d01`, `examples/app-crm`, started with `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh -p 4682` and used only as a backend.
- Front ends, both run with Vite from this branch's worktree and proxied to 4682:
  - `apps/console` on port 5682;
  - `examples/console-starter` on port 5683, which routes `/login` to app-shell's exported `DefaultLoginPage`.
- Playwright with Chromium routed `GET /api/v1/auth/config` to the backend's own answer, with two changes: `features.ssoEnforced` set as stated per row, and one OIDC provider appended, `{ id: 'acme-idp', name: 'Acme IdP', enabled: true, type: 'oidc' }`. That is the entry shape the server's `getPublicConfig` emits for `oidcProviders`. The answer was delayed 3 s to widen the pending window. No OIDC provider was configured on the backend itself.

**`DefaultLoginPage` (`examples/console-starter`)**

| State | Before: `e219a3d`, unchanged main | After: `e74debc` |
|---|---|---|
| enforced, spinner showing | "Sign in to your account" / "Enter your email and password to continue" | "Sign in to your account", no description |
| enforced, config resolved | SSO-only line, "Continue with Acme IdP", "OR CONTINUE WITH EMAIL", then only "Use a password instead" (no email input) | SSO-only line, "Continue with Acme IdP", "Use a password instead". No divider. |
| enforced, after "Use a password instead" | divider, email input, password input | divider, email input, password input |
| not enforced, spinner showing | "Enter your email and password to continue" | no description |
| not enforced, config resolved | description, provider button, divider, Email, Password | unchanged |

**Console `LoginPage` (`apps/console`)**

| State | Before: `e219a3d`, unchanged main | After: `e74debc` |
|---|---|---|
| enforced, spinner showing | "Welcome back" / "Sign in to continue your work" (no password copy) | unchanged |
| enforced, config resolved | SSO-only line, "Continue with Acme IdP", "OR CONTINUE WITH EMAIL", then only "Use a password instead" | SSO-only line, "Continue with Acme IdP", "Use a password instead". No divider. |
| enforced, after "Use a password instead" | divider, email input, password input | divider, email input, password input |
| not enforced, config resolved | provider button, divider, Email, Password | unchanged |

**Where the pending caption shows.** On today's `main` the console app's own `LoginPage` renders `LoginForm` with `hideHeader` (objectui#12600). Its card draws its own neutral two-line header, so the pending-caption half of the card does not appear on `apps/console`'s `/login`. The QA run used vendored console `daeb77fc`, whose `LoginPage` still passed `title` and `description` from `auth.login.*`, and `hideHeader` landed after that build. The pending caption still shows on app-shell's exported `DefaultLoginPage`, which passes `description={t('auth.login.description')}`, and on any `LoginForm` rendered with its header. The divider half shows on both pages.

## Tests

All runs are at `e74debc`.

- **New pins:** `packages/auth/src/__tests__/ssoEnforcedLoginCopy-12682.test.tsx`, 8 cases.
  - Run against unchanged source (the test file added, no fix): `Tests 4 failed | 4 passed (8)`.
    - Red, as intended: the pending caption with the default description, the pending caption with a host-passed description, no divider under enforcement until the break-glass click, and `hideDivider` omits the divider.
    - Green, as controls: `hideHeader` shows no description while pending, a failed config read shows the description, a server without enforcement keeps the divider, email form and description, and `SocialSignInButtons` draws its divider by default.
  - After the fix: `Tests 8 passed (8)`.
- **`RegisterForm` keeps its divider.** The existing pin `RegisterForm — social button labels (objectui#10900)` › `unset labels keep the English defaults` holds this, and ablation A5 below turns it red.
- **Package and consumer tests:** `pnpm exec vitest run packages/auth/ packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/ apps/console/src/pages/auth/` gives `Test Files 56 passed (56)` and `Tests 449 passed (449)`.

### Ablations, one per pin

Each leg went through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. In every leg the anchor hit once, the file's blob changed, the restored blob equalled `HEAD`, and `git diff HEAD` was empty afterwards.

| Leg | Mutation | Turned red |
|---|---|---|
| A1b | header description back to `ssoOnlyView ? l.ssoOnlyDescription : description` | both pending-caption pins |
| A2 | `LoginForm` passes no `hideDivider` | enforced-divider pin |
| A3 | `SocialSignInButtons` ignores `hideDivider` | enforced-divider pin, `hideDivider` pin |
| A4 | `LoginForm` passes `hideDivider={true}` | enforced-divider pin (after break-glass), non-enforced control |
| A5 | `hideDivider` default flipped to `true` | default-divider control, both `RegisterForm` 10900 pins |
| A6 | `hideHeader` branch shows the SSO-only line while pending | `hideHeader`-pending control |
| A7b | description never shown | failed-config control, non-enforced control, both pending-caption pins |

The first attempts at A1 and A7 did nothing. The tool refused them because the replacement text already occurred in the file, so its count could not rise, and no test ran. Both were re-run with a marker comment in the replacement, as A1b and A7b.

## Local gates

All gates ran at `e74debc`. Exit codes were captured before any pipe.

- `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/auth...' build` exited 0 and printed `dist completeness: 1 package(s) complete`. `@object-ui/auth^...` matches no workspace package, so the closure is auth alone.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/auth type-check` exited 0. It runs `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, and `--listFilesOnly` lists the new test.
- `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/console^...' build` (35 packages) exited 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check` then exited 0 against the rebuilt `@object-ui/auth` declarations.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the three changed `.tsx` files exited 0 with 0 errors and 2 warnings. Both warnings are on lines this PR does not touch: `hasSocialProviders` is assigned and never used, and an effect's dependency list leaves out `onProvidersResolved`.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` exited 0.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` exited 0 and reported `0 new citation(s)`.
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys` was not run because no bundle changed.

## Acceptance notes

- **Card mechanism.** The card says the console page passes the header description. On today's `main` it passes `hideHeader` instead, as described under "Where the pending caption shows" above. The fix lives in `LoginForm` either way, so every host that renders the header is covered.
- **Untranslated SSO-only copy, outside this card's scope.** Under zh-CN, the console's SSO-only view shows the SSO-only line and the break-glass link in English, "Sign in with your organization's single sign-on" and "Use a password instead", while the rest of the page is Chinese. Neither login page passes `ssoOnlyDescription`, `usePasswordText` or `backToSsoText`, and no bundle has keys for them. This was measured live on `/login` with `features.ssoEnforced: true`. It goes to the report for the seat, and this PR does not change it.
- **Dead state.** `LoginForm`'s `hasSocialProviders` state is set and never read. This is noted only.
